part.text:
I've called rest, but I'm not confident the robot is in front of the green panel.

The robot reached the end of the corridor and turned left toward the green panel. On the last few approach steps, though, the panel moved from straight ahead to the left side of the view. The robot now seems to be beside the panel's edge, not squarely facing it. Its position is roughly x 3.5 m, y 3.1 m, and the robot is crouched with motors off.

If you want it exactly in front of the panel, I can stand it up and make a small sideways correction. I can also keep going with a different approach.
